text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Needs a few days of rest," huh...? What 
in the world am I doing, getting injured 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I knew I was tired, but if I wasn't 
practicing, I felt like I wasn't moving 
forward, and it made me anxious..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't worry, I can keep 
practicing! I think the doctor was just 
exaggerating anyway.
choice_data_list: I need you to rest for now.

Let's push through this injury with sheer 
willpower!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even without that, with my modeling work, 
I already get less practice time than the 
others...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just resting without doing anything... The 
impatience is driving me crazy!
choice_data_list:
I'll plan out your training menu for when 
you return.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, it stings, but I got it. I'll 
check with my manager about the schedule.

And so, Gold City was forced to take a 
period of rest...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, why are you getting so fired up all 
of a sudden? ...Well, I get how you feel, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to fall behind from an 
injury. I need to get back on the track 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way... It hurts just to walk. I won't 
be able to practice properly at all like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Do I really have to just sit still and do 
nothing like this...?"

"First, healing your injury comes before 
anything else. That was what I told a 
despondent Gold City."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to fall behind from an 
injury. I need to get back on the track 
right now—
choice_data_list:
We're having our strategy meeting in the 
infirmary today.

We're having our strategy meeting in the 
infirmary today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm gonna power through right now 
on sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, sorry. I was totally panicking. 
How we overcome this is what really 
matters, right?"

Afterward, the two of us came up with 
exercises mindful of the injury, and 
managed to make slow but steady progress.
